Here is what the search and record read found:

**1860 Census — George Ackerman, Pennsylvania**

A search of the 1860 United States Census (FamilySearch collection 1473181) returned one strong match:
- **George Ackerman**, born ~1818 in Pennsylvania, residing in **Bucks County, Pennsylvania** in 1860. Match score: 0.94.

The indexed household (record ARK M7QZ-8KD) lists **George Ackerman**, **Henry Ackerman**, and **Margaret Ackerman**. Catherine does not appear by name in this particular indexed entry — she may have her own separate indexed persona from the same household (possibly already in the project as ARK M4QZ-7YT).

**What the record shows about the marriage:**
The 1860 federal census recorded **no marital status and no family relationships**. That relationship-to-head-of-household column didn't appear until the **1880 census**.
